connectionFields.name: Bot User OAuth Token
connectionFields.obtainedHow: From the Slack app OAuth & Permissions page after install (xoxb- prefix). Store in the operator vault.

connectionFields.name: User OAuth Token
connectionFields.obtainedHow: User OAuth token from the same page (xoxp- prefix). Store in the operator vault.

connectionFields.name: App-Level Token
connectionFields.obtainedHow: Socket-mode app-level token (xapp- prefix) generated on Basic Information → App-Level Tokens.

prepSteps.title: Create the Slack app from Entro's manifest
prepSteps.instruction: At api.slack.com/apps, create an app from manifest, paste Entro's manifest, install it to the workspace, and generate the socket-mode app-level token.
prepSteps.evidence: The workspace Apps list includes Entro Security

uncataloged.evidence: The workspace Apps list includes Entro Security

prepSteps.title: Copy OAuth tokens into the vault
prepSteps.instruction: On OAuth & Permissions, copy Bot and User tokens into the operator vault. Do not paste them into chat.
prepSteps.evidence: OAuth & Permissions shows installed tokens (values stored outside the session)

uncataloged.evidence: OAuth & Permissions shows installed tokens (values stored outside the session)

connectionFields.name: Workspace
connectionFields.obtainedHow: Target workspace name selected in Entro after the Grid org install.

prepSteps.title: Install the Entro Grid app
prepSteps.instruction: As an org admin, install Entro's Enterprise Grid Slack app at the org, then in Entro pick Worker Group and the target workspace.
prepSteps.evidence: Slack org apps lists Entro and Entro shows the workspace selectable

uncataloged.evidence: Slack org apps lists Entro and Entro shows the workspace selectable

summary: Connect a standard Slack workspace via an Entro Slack app installed from a manifest.
